narrative.overview: A gear-care publication that dresses like outdoor sportswear: giant uppercase Inter at weight 800, and full-bleed colour fields that each own a whole section. The page reads as a stack of banners (red, coral, sand, near-black), separated by the cream paper they sit on. There is one typeface, no motion, and no tracking, and the system leans on scale and colour instead of ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Committed colour: red is a full-bleed field, not an accent.
One family (Inter Variable); hierarchy comes from size and weight 800 vs 400.
Outlined pill buttons, hairline rules, square-cornered image areas.
Flat and still: no shadows, no animation, no gradients.
Photo areas are placeholders: the wobble mark tone-on-tone on a colour field.
Light and dark themes, switched per page view with nothing stored.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: Colour lives in full-bleed regions that own a section. Each field sets its own text, button, link, and mark colours; children inherit them. Never lay a small coloured patch on top of another field.

rules.name: The Brown Rule
rules.body: The owner's brown (#8C5C32) is deliberately unused. Do not introduce it.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Warm Rule
rules.body: Cream text goes only on red and night fields; Bark Ink goes on coral and sand.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter only. Do not add a second face; change weight or size instead.

rules.name: The Shout Once Rule
rules.body: Uppercase 800 is for display, headline, tile names, nav and buttons. Body, leads, and metadata stay sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not lift. State is shown by colour inversion, never by shadow or motion.

dos: Do give each section one full-bleed field (red, coral, sand, or night) and let its tokens style the children.
Do set display and headline in Inter 800 uppercase with negative tracking.
Do use pill buttons with 2px borders; invert on hover.
Do keep ink-on-warm pairings: cream on red and night, Bark Ink on coral and sand.
Do keep placeholders as the wobble mark on a colour field until real photos exist.
Do keep visible 3px focus outlines in both themes.
donts: Don't add a second typeface, shadows, gradients, or animation.
Don't round image areas or tiles.
Don't replace rails with a uniform card grid.
Don't store the theme choice (no cookie, no localStorage).
